sources.title: Lease Blob (REST API) - Azure Storage
observations: PUT blob path with comp=lease; acquire 201, renew/release 200; no response body.
Acquire accepts a proposed UUID and duration 15 to 60 seconds; renew/release require the held ID.
Acquire and renew return lease ID; conditional headers are supported.
Blob leases restrict blob writes/deletes but do not prevent container deletion.
Service can renew some expired leases; local implementation deliberately refuses an expired capability.
Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/containers/blobs/write is required; read observations alone do not establish this grant.
